description: This PHP class defines a view for deleting a package within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder module. It handles the display logic when a package has been deleted, presenting a notification message to the user.

classes.name: Viewdeletepackage
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView, responsible for displaying a message when a package has been deleted in ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters for the view, including the module name and title obtained from ModuleBuilderController.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the JavaScript code to display a message that a package has been deleted, using the AjaxCompose class.
